segments.text: Guitarist & Vocalist of Lemonade Factory
A girl who transfers into the protagonist's school.
She usually maintains a calm demeanor, but she also has a tendency to charge ahead once she gets an idea in her head.
She is actually severely nearsighted.
Translated from official website
主人公の学園に転校してくる女の子。
普段は落ち着いた雰囲気なのだが、思い込んだら突っ走るところもある。
実は極度の近視。
レモネードファクトリー　ギター・ボーカル担当

Lead Guitarist of Lemonade Factory
A girl who is a part-time job colleague of the protagonist.
She can be cheeky, but her bright personality makes her hard to dislike.
For some reason, she tries to keep her private life secret.
Translated from official website
主人公のバイト仲間の女の子。
ちょっと小生意気だが憎めない、明るい性格の持ち主。
なぜか私生活を秘密にしたがる。
レモネードファクトリー　リードギター担当

Keyboardist of Lemonade Factory
An ojousama who has studied piano since childhood.
Though she maintains a gentle demeanor, she is strong-minded and won't hesitate to refuse things she dislikes.
She is somehow familiar with erotic issues...
Translated from official website
幼い頃からピアノを学んできた、お嬢様。
穏やかな雰囲気ではあるが、嫌なことは嫌だと言える意志の強さを持っている。
エッチなことも、なぜか詳しい……。

SNS Manager of Lemonade Factory
The protagonist's childhood friend.
She doesn't sweat the small stuff and has an outspoken personality.
Bad at waking up in the morning, she has the protagonist wake her up.
Translated from official website
主人公の幼馴染み。
細かいことは気にしない、あけすけな性格。
朝が苦手なので、主人公に起こしてもらっている。

細かいことは気にしない、あけすけな性格。
朝が苦手なので、主人公に起こしてもらっている。
Bassist of gem of rubble
A conscientious and slightly strong-willed girl.
Though from a different band than the protagonist's, she acknowledged their skill after hearing them perform and declared herself their rival—
though in truth, she's less a rival and more just a fan.
Translated from official website
しっかり者で、ちょっと気の強い女の子。
主人公たちとは別のバンドだが、その演奏を聞いて腕前を認め、ライバルを自称する。
――が、ライバルと言うよりもただのファン。

Protagonist's older female cousin.
She is the one who inspired the protagonist to start playing bass.
She earns her living as a professional music creator.
